map.面积与周长按形状公式计算：矩形 = 长 × 宽，周长 = 2 ×（长 + 宽），: Area and perimeter by shape formulas: rectangle = length × width, perimeter = 2 × (length + width), diagonal = √(length² + width²); L-shape = large rectangle area − missing rectangle area; trapezoid = (upper base + lower base) × height ÷ 2; triangle = base × height ÷ 2; circle = π × radius², perimeter = 2πr; usage estimate by area × (1 + loss rate 5% to 10%) to convert tiles or wallpaper usage.
map.矩形房 长 × 宽 直接得面积，再乘地砖单块面积（800×800=0.64㎡）估: Rectangular room length × width gives area directly, then divide by tile single area (800×800=0.64 m²) to estimate count and add loss.
map.L 形拆两个矩形求和；梯形用 (上底 + 下底) × 高 ÷ 2；圆形用 πr²: L-shape split into two rectangles and sum; trapezoid uses (upper base + lower base) × height ÷ 2; circle uses πr²; each fits different layouts.
map.不规则房用「包围盒 − 缺口」近似，或分块累加，快速估壁纸 / 地板用量。: Irregular room uses 'bounding box − notch' approximation, or block accumulation, to quickly estimate wallpaper/floor usage.
map.矩形 4×3.5=14㎡，800×800 砖 0.64㎡/块 → 14÷0.64: Rectangle 4×3.5=14 m², 800×800 tile 0.64 m²/piece → 14÷0.64≈22 pieces, +5% loss ≈ 23 pieces. L-shape = 3×2 + 2×1.5 = 6+3 = 9 m². Perimeter is for wall painting/baseboard: rectangle perimeter = 2×(length+width).
map.地砖 5%、墙砖 8–10%（切角多）、壁纸 10–15%；异形房间取高值。本工: Floor tile 5%, wall tile 8-10% (more cutting), wallpaper 10-15%; irregular room takes high value. This tool gives net area; loss added separately at purchase.
map.墙面刷漆、踢脚线、阴角线均按周长 × 层高（或线宽）计。矩形周长 = 2×(长+: Wall painting, baseboard, corner line all by perimeter × ceiling height (or line width). Rectangle perimeter = 2×(length+width), L-shape sums each outer contour segment.
